title: Cornflakes-Coated Chicken
description: Cornflakes-Coated Chicken is a Continental-style crispy chicken dish featuring tender chicken breast fillets coated in crunchy cornflakes, Parmesan, and herbs. It is served with a Continental herb dip, fresh microgreens, and lemon wedges for a refined restaurant-quality presentation.

ingredients.title: For the Chicken
items: Chicken breast fillets – 4 pieces (about 180–200 g each), skinless, boneless

ingredients.title: For the Coating
items: Cornflakes – 150 g (lightly crushed, not powdered; should remain flaky for crunch)
Eggs – 2 large, lightly beaten with 2 tbsp milk
Parmesan cheese – 30 g, finely grated (optional, adds umami depth)

ingredients.title: For Frying / Baking
items: Neutral oil (grapeseed, sunflower, or canola) – for shallow frying
Melted butter + a drizzle of oil – for baking

ingredients.title: For Garnish & Service
items: Aioli or a Continental herb dip (see below)

ingredients.title: Continental Herb Dip (Optional but Recommended)
items: Fresh dill or chives – 1 tbsp, finely chopped

instruction.title: Step 1 – Prepare the Chicken
steps: Lightly pound the chicken breasts to even thickness (about 1.5 cm).
Season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika, lemon juice, and Dijon mustard.
Let marinate for 20–30 minutes for deeper flavor.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Set Up Breading Station
steps: Bowl 3: Cornflakes, parmesan, parsley (lightly crushed, not too fine).

instruction.title: Step 3 – Coat the Chicken
steps: Dredge chicken in flour (shake off excess).
Press firmly into cornflake mixture so flakes adhere evenly.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Cooking Options
steps: Shallow Frying (restaurant crispness): Heat oil in a sauté pan to 170–175°C. Fry chicken fillets 3–4 minutes per side until golden brown and internal temp reaches 74°C. Drain on paper towel.
Oven-Baking (lighter option): Preheat oven to 200°C. Place coated chicken on a rack set over a tray. Brush lightly with melted butter + oil mix. Bake 18–20 minutes, flipping once, until golden crisp.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Rest & Serve
steps: Plate with microgreens, lemon wedge, and a quenelle of herb dip.

instruction.title: Step 6 – Presentation
steps: Slice chicken diagonally into 3 thick strips and fan out on the plate.
Add a small salad of mesclun leaves dressed with lemon vinaigrette.
Drizzle a fine line of herb dip or aioli beside the chicken.
Finish with a sprinkle of micro herbs or edible flowers.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve with aioli or the Continental herb dip.
Pair with a small salad of mesclun leaves dressed with lemon vinaigrette.
Garnish with microgreens or watercress and lemon wedges.

chefTips: For extra crunch, double-dip (egg wash → cornflakes → egg wash → cornflakes) but keep flakes coarse.
Parmesan in the crust adds depth, giving it a Continental flair beyond classic fried chicken.
